scope: 0.4.2 WhatsApp account merchant selection and customer search

contract.state_selected_merchant_ids: Persisted account workspace selection, independent of automatic authorization; initially empty for existing workspaces.
contract.state_allowed_merchant_ids: In-memory authorized automatic reception scope; empty after disconnect or restart.
contract.selection_save: set_whatsapp_reception with identity and allowed_merchant_ids saves the selection even when enabled is false. To save without granting, pass enabled=false. To disable without changing selection, pass the existing selected_merchant_ids. Calls without allowed_merchant_ids only disable.
contract.default: default_merchant_id/default_revision remain independently saved with save_whatsapp_default_merchant and apply to new contacts.
contract.selection_change: Changing selection persists reception_paused on this account's existing contacts, cancels generation and preserves their human_owned state, bindings and operations. takeover_whatsapp(enabled=false) resumes a contact.
contract.customer_search: Each candidate includes conversation_id, name, buyer_id and revision; buyer_id comes from the merchant's saved conversation metadata.

validation.test: vitest broker and customer panel targeted invocation

limits: Synthetic data and substitutes only; no live accounts, paid model requests, build or release.
Launcher and extension UI need to consume selected_merchant_ids and buyer_id; existing frontend behavior is not changed by this task.
Existing workspaces have no persisted merchant selection until saved; no prior in-memory authorization is inferred.
